Title: "Little Hearts" is prominently displayed at the top with a tagline: "No Touching, Only Heart-Thrilling." Tagline: Below the title, it says, "In Cinemas Now!" indicating that the movie is currently available for viewing. Box Office Performance: Day 1: 2.54
